# Sandbox

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/sandbox/sandbox.h`](../../../src/logic/sandbox/sandbox.h) · Described in `data/world.json`

World context variable of the sandbox: the rules of life, the species, the grass, the counters.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `params` | `LifeParams` | the life params in use: `base` with the environment parameters lifeScale, walkerShare, rewardScale applied at every window |
| `base` | `LifeParams` | as the file (with the scene's overrides) has them |
| `species` | `std::vector<SandboxSpecies>` | per species: its SpeciesLife, bodies and scales by growth stage and the ages they begin, walker params, gait ranges, reward program, walker and action behaviour names, weapon segment, and counters since the world began (born, spawned, starved, killed, aged, kills, falls, lives, lifetime, work, moved, ticks, alive) |
| `grass` | `GrassField` | the grid of grass heights of the arena, eaten and growing back |
| `by_group` | `std::unordered_map<uint32_t, entt::entity>` | the animal of each ragdoll collision group (to read the contact events) |
| `next_group` | `uint32_t` | the next ragdoll group, from 1 |
| `windows` | `uint64_t` | Observe phases so far (minds are due when (windows + phase) % mind_every == 0) |
| `seconds` | `double` | simulated since the start or the last RESET |
| `puppet` | `bool` | a check: kinematic bodies slid along their command, no walker agents |
| `heuristic` | `bool` | the scripted minds answer the minds nothing answered (in Sandbox's tick) |
| `draw` | `bool` | shapes (Transform + WorldShape + ModelRef) per body and grass tiles for WorldView |
| `rewards_dir` | `std::string` | resources folder of <species>.rewards.json |
| `contacts` | `uint64_t` | contacts between two animals so far |
| `blows` | `uint64_t` | ... of which wounded |

## Notes

Emplaced by Sandbox in preinit, one per sandbox world; read by SandboxLife, SandboxObserve, SandboxHeuristic, the free functions spawnSandboxAnimal / observeSandboxMind / sandboxSignals, SandboxWatch (viewer) and TrainHost (eval). Its presence makes TrainHost treat the scene as a sandbox scene.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: SandboxHeuristic, SandboxWatch, TrainHost. Written by: Sandbox, SandboxLife, SandboxObserve. Created by: Sandbox. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Sandbox](../systems/Sandbox.md) | system | World | **write+create** | preinit | made from the life params file with the scene's overrides, the species' bodies by growth stage, walker params and reward programs |
| [Sandbox](../systems/Sandbox.md) | system | World | **readwrite** | init, tick, finish | grass field made in init; species counters, `by_group`, `next_group` kept by every birth, death and newcomer |

| [SandboxObserve](../systems/SandboxObserve.md) | system | World | **readwrite** | tick | `windows` counted; on a RESET the grass made again, the animals again (populate), `seconds` 0; species reward programs read |
| [SandboxWatch](../systems/SandboxWatch.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick, pick (world 0's registry) | present or the system does nothing; species[...].life id and predator for the first pick |
| [TrainHost](../systems/service-TrainHost.md) | service | World | **read** | sandboxWorlds, evalSandbox | is this a sandbox scene; species counters, grass, contacts and blows for the summary |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Sandbox](../systems/Sandbox.md)**
  - Reads resources/agents/params/life.params.json (or `life`), resources/agents/params/animal.params.json, the generated bodies resources/animals/bodies/<id>.body.json and resources/agents/rewards/<id>.rewards.json (hashes kept); throws std::runtime_error on a missing life file, an unknown species or a weapon segment the body lacks.
  - Builds a Jolt ragdoll per animal (bodies and constraints in the animal collision layer, group = its ragdoll group), destroys it when the animal leaves or grows; four static wall boxes round the arena.
  - Installs SandboxSys::Contacts as the PhysicsSystem's contact listener: it records the estimated impulse of every contact between two ragdolls (from Jolt's threads, under a mutex) for SandboxLife.
  - Creates and destroys entities: animals, minds, drawn shapes and grass tiles.
  - Logs one debug line per species at init (count, bodies, standing muzzle height, reward terms and round).
- **[SandboxHeuristic](../systems/SandboxHeuristic.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[SandboxLife](../systems/SandboxLife.md)**
  - Drains the contact listener's recorded events (the listener is SandboxSys's).
- **[SandboxObserve](../systems/SandboxObserve.md)**
  - On a RESET: every animal and its ragdoll destroyed and the population drawn again (entities and Jolt bodies created and destroyed).
- **[SandboxWatch](../systems/SandboxWatch.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[TrainHost](../systems/service-TrainHost.md)**
  - gRPC client of the ML-Agents trainer (MlAgentsClient on localhost:<port>); reads the environment parameters and engine configuration side channels.
  - Files: envparams.txt (-envParamsOut, written on change), .demo (record-demo), eval summaries (var.out), replays (<prefix>.track.*, .replay.*, .sandbox.*, .grass.bin), legs CSV, cot_out, demo checks JSON.
  - tf::Executor workers for bench, eval and the worlds' steps.
  - Restarts the worlds with the trainer's seed (ScenarioRunner::restart) when the trainer connects in mode=train.
  - Logs the mode's progress and summaries; exit codes 0 (QUIT, stop signal), 1 (bad arguments), 2 (connection lost).
